basic_details.job_title: KGMU Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Applications on plain paper are invited for 1 post of Clinical Psychologist on a contractual basis in the Department of Psychiatry at King George's Medical University, U.P., Lucknow, under the M.Phil in Clinical Psychology course funded by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, New Delhi. Eligible candidates possessing an M.Phil in Clinical Psychology from an RCI-recognized university must ensure their applications reach the Office of the Head, Department of Psychiatry, King George's Medical University, U.P., Lucknow-226003, before the receipt deadline of 31 October 2026 at 04:00 PM.

qualification.details: Minimum Qualification: M.Phil in Clinical Psychology from any RCI recognized University in India. Preference: Preference will be given to candidates with a Ph.D in the field of Psychology and one or more years teaching and working experience in a large hospital. Age Limit: The official notification does not specify the age limit. Tenure & Scheme: The appointment is on a contractual basis till 31 March 2027 for the M.Phil in Clinical Psychology course under Manpower Development Scheme-B funded by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, New Delhi, in the Department of Psychiatry, K.G Medical University, U.P., Lucknow. | FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? selection_process: Selection will be made on the basis of an interview. The details of the interview are as follows:
Date of Interview: 5 November 2026 (Thursday) Reporting Time: 10:00 AM Venue: Office of the Head
Lucknow Call Letters: No separate call letters will be issued for this interview. Travel Allowance: No T.A./D.A. will be paid towards appearing in the interview.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis till 31 March 2027 under Manpower Development Scheme-B. In-service candidates must carry a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of the interview. No separate call letters will be dispatched; candidates who submitted applications must report directly for the interview as scheduled. No travel allowance or dearness allowance (T.A./D.A.) will be provided for attending the interview. Applications arriving after 04:00 PM on 31 October 2026 will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under KGMU Clinical Psychologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacant post for Clinical Psychologist in the Department of Psychiatry at King George's Medical University, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 31 October 2026 before 04:00 PM at the office of the Head, Department of Psychiatry, KGMU, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Phil in Clinical Psychology from any RCI-recognized university in India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary or honorarium for the post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How should candidates apply for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply on plain paper and submit it along with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, mark-sheets, RCI registration, and one photograph to the Office of the Head, Department of Psychiatry, King George's Medical University, U.P., Lucknow-226003.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Clinical Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Selection will be conducted through an interview on 5 November 2026 at 10:00 AM in the office of the Head, Department of Psychiatry, KGMU, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Clinical Psychologist post permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The post is purely on a contractual basis till 31 March 2027 for the M.Phil in Clinical Psychology course under Manpower Development Scheme-B funded by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What are the preferred qualifications mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates holding a Ph.D in the field of Psychology and having one or more years of teaching and working experience in a large hospital.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are required from in-service candidates?
faq.answer: In-service candidates must bring a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) from their current employer at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Will candidates receive call letters or TA/DA for the interview?
faq.answer: No separate call letters will be issued for the interview, and no T.A./D.A. will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.
